description: With lifelike appearance and natural color, these artificial eucalyptus stems are perfect for adding a bit of nature and all its beauty to your home, wedding or many other occasions without the hassle and maintenance of fresh plants. They are perfect for wedding flowers decorations, wedding table centerpieces, garland, wreath, floral arrangement or just placing in vases, baskets, canisters or tin buckets for a simple but elegant displaying.
Requiring no water, fertilizer or sunlight, there are various usages for artificial eucalyptus stems.
1. Place the faux eucalyptus spray in a simple vase, basket, canister or tin bucket for minimalist styling.
2. Beautiful and delicate, this is a wonderful accent to your flower arrangements. Combine with other flowers or cut apart to add a touch of dusty green to your designs.

3. Our eucalyptus stems are ready to be used in floral bouquets, wedding tabletops, door decor, to accent signs and wall hangings, or to make wedding centerpieces, door wreaths, arch backdrops and so much more!
4. These are ideal for decorating your venue during special events and each single stem will enhance your decorations for side tables, centerpieces, or windowsills.
